name: @crm/if-party-master
description: IF Party Master microfrontend for CRM

scripts.dev:microfrontend: cross-env WEBPACK_DEPLOYMENT_MODE=microfrontend webpack serve --config webpack.config.js --mode development
scripts.build: cross-env NODE_ENV=production tsc --noEmit && cross-env NODE_ENV=production webpack --config webpack.config.js --mode production
scripts.build:microfrontend: cross-env NODE_ENV=production WEBPACK_DEPLOYMENT_MODE=microfrontend tsc --noEmit && cross-env NODE_ENV=production WEBPACK_DEPLOYMENT_MODE=microfrontend webpack --config webpack.config.js --mode production
scripts.build:webresource: cross-env NODE_ENV=production WEBPACK_DEPLOYMENT_MODE=web_resource tsc --noEmit && cross-env NODE_ENV=production WEBPACK_DEPLOYMENT_MODE=web_resource webpack --config webpack.config.js --mode production
